sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com), Yuno Grinberryall: the spirit technique list (Sylph's Breath, Spirit Dive, Spirit Storm, Spirit's Hushed Dance, Liable Tempest (anime-only), Spirit of Zephyr, Spirit of Boreas, Spirit of Euros, Spirit of Notos, Saint Stage ...) and the Wind Magic page. Read through search summaries only: the wiki host is not reachable from the build machine.
sources.ja_search: Japanese pages found by search (manga-tantei, pixiv encyclopedia, renote spell lists, shonenjump.com character file): Japanese spell names and one-line effects.
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs (the exact first chapter or episode of most spells was not confirmed): see docs/magic/character_spells.md.

spells.name: Wind Magic: Crescent Kamaitachi
spells.note: Yuno's first wind blade. Mode 0 of the Wind book, so it stays in the basic book too.

spells.name: Wind Magic: Towering Tornado
spells.note: A tornado from the ground to the sky.

spells.name: Wind Magic: Tornado Fang
spells.note: The horizontal version of the Towering Tornado (the Japanese list says so), so it follows it.

spells.name: Wind Creation Magic: Wind Blades Shower
Wind Creation Magic: Swift White Hawk
spells.note: A hawk of wind he rides.

spells.name: Wind Creation Magic: Gale White Bow
spells.note: A great bow of wind; Sylph's breath looses the arrow.

spells.name: Wind Creation Magic: Heavenly Wind Ark
spells.note: A ship of wind that carries many people.

spells.name: Wind Spirit Magic: Sylph's Breath
spells.note: Needs the Sylph bond (she chooses him in the dungeon): from then on, the first Spirit Magic.

spells.name: Wind Spirit Magic: Spirit Storm
spells.ja: スピリット・ストーム
spells.note: Condensed wind used while in Spirit Dive (the Japanese list), so it needs the Dive cast once.

spells.name: Wind Spirit Magic: Spirit's Hushed Dance
spells.note: A Mana Zone spell used in Spirit Dive: reads the flow of mana to dodge, even Light Magic, leaving afterimages.

spells.name: Wind Spirit Creation Magic: Spirit of Zephyr
spells.ja: スピリット・オブ・ゼファー
spells.note: The owner's example: Spirit of Zephyr is a spell used AFTER Spirit Dive was gained, so it waits for the Dive to have been cast.

spells.name: Liable Tempest
spells.note: Listed by the wiki as anime-only. The effect is inferred from the name (a violent tempest zone); no description was found.

spells.name: Wind Spirit Creation Magic: Spirit of Boreas
spells.note: The wiki lists it as a Wind, Spirit and Creation Magic spell, offensive and close range. Saint Stage (near 100% resonance with Sylph) comes first.

spells.name: Wind Spirit Magic: Spirit of Notos
spells.note: Spirit of Notus (manga ch.360): a wind shield that pushes back attacks and enemies and gave Yuno room to land a hit on Lucius.

spells.name: Wind Spirit Creation Magic: Saint Spirit of Zephyr
spells.note: The Saint Stage form of Spirit of Zephyr (named on the wiki; the effect is designed).

planned.name: Spirit of Euros
planned.note: Named in the wiki's spirit list; no description found, no page yet.

planned.name: Spirit of Notos
planned.note: Named in the wiki's spirit list; no description found, no page yet.

planned.name: Saint Spirit of Zephyr
planned.note: The Saint Stage version of Spirit of Zephyr (also seen against Zenon). Should be a stronger form of the same page once Saint Stage is reached.

planned.name: Saint Spirit of Boreas
planned.note: The Saint Stage version of Spirit of Boreas.

planned.name: Union Magic: Never-Never Land
planned.note: Star Magic combined with Sylph's wind: a rotating dome of stars over the whole kingdom. Needs Star Magic, which is a second attribute and not part of the Wind book.

planned.name: Star Magic
planned.note: Yuno's second attribute (a VfxShape STAR_MAGIC exists); a different book.

notes: Not in Yuno's grimoire (kept in the basic Wind book): Gust Lane and Slicing Wind Emperor were not found in any source for Yuno. Spirit Dive itself is the book's universal Spirit page. Pages 15 (batch 3): the entries after the first ones are the new shared pages of the book (and some older pages of it), none exclusive, so the basic grimoire keeps showing them too.
